steps.name: Check if database schema or Supabase CLI version changed
steps.run:
# This is a pre-merge gate, so it only has a meaningful base to diff against on
# pull_request runs. publish.yml calls this same reusable workflow from a push to master
# (and from workflow_dispatch), where github.base_ref is empty and HEAD is already the
# branch tip. Skip explicitly there rather than relying on the diff coming back empty:
# the pull request that produced the commit already ran this check.
if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
  echo "Not a pull request run (no base ref), so there is nothing to diff against."
  echo "The codegen check already ran on the pull request for this commit."
  echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
# Fail closed. If the base cannot be fetched or diffed we must not fall through to
# "nothing changed" and skip the gate: a silently skipped codegen check is exactly how
# the drift this step guards against went unnoticed for months.
if ! git fetch origin "$BASE_REF"; then
  echo "::error::Could not fetch origin/${BASE_REF}, so we cannot tell whether the generated types need checking."
  exit 1
fi
if ! CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "origin/${BASE_REF}...HEAD"); then
  echo "::error::Could not diff against origin/${BASE_REF}, refusing to skip the codegen check."
  exit 1
fi
# types.generated.ts depends on the test schema AND on the pinned Supabase CLI version,
# which selects the postgres-meta image that does the introspection. Watch both, or a
# CLI bump silently changes the generated output with nothing to catch it.
if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" \
  | grep -qE '^packages/core/postgrest-js/test/supabase/|^package\.json$'; then
  echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Verify generated types are in sync
steps.run: pnpm run codegen:check:postgrest

steps.name: Skip codegen check
steps.run: echo "⏭️  Skipping codegen check — no test schema or Supabase CLI version changes detected"

steps.name: Check if actor is member of admin or sdk team
Fail if not authorized

steps.name: Update npm
steps.run: corepack enable npm && corepack prepare npm@11 --activate

steps.name: Deprecate package versions
steps.run:
PACKAGES=(
  "supabase-js"
  "auth-js"
  "functions-js"
  "realtime-js"
  "storage-js"
  "postgrest-js"
  "gotrue-js"
)

FAILED=0

for pkg in "${PACKAGES[@]}"; do
  FULL_PKG="@supabase/${pkg}"

  echo "============================================"
  echo "Deprecating ${FULL_PKG}@${VERSION}"
  echo "Message: ${MESSAGE}"
  echo "============================================"

  if npm deprecate "${FULL_PKG}@${VERSION}" "${MESSAGE}"; then
    echo "✅ Successfully deprecated ${FULL_PKG}@${VERSION}"
  else
    echo "❌ Failed to deprecate ${FULL_PKG}@${VERSION}"
    FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))
  fi

  echo ""
done

if [ "$FAILED" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "⚠️ ${FAILED} package(s) failed to deprecate."
  exit 1
fi

echo "🎉 All packages deprecated successfully!"

pipelines.name: Dogfood

steps.name: Check if actor is member of admin or sdk team
Fail if not authorized
steps.run:
echo "You must be a member of @supabase/admin or @supabase/sdk."
exit 1

steps.name: Wait for the version to be resolvable on npm
steps.run:
# The downstream workflows run `npm install` / `pnpm install` against the public
# registry. Right after a publish the registry can take a minute or more to serve
# the new version, and every downstream run then fails with "No matching version
# found". Poll the same abbreviated packument the installers use until every
# package resolves at the requested version, or give up after 10 minutes.
set -o pipefail
# The npm packument keys versions without a leading "v".
VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
packages="@supabase/supabase-js @supabase/auth-js @supabase/functions-js @supabase/postgrest-js @supabase/realtime-js @supabase/storage-js"
attempts=40
interval=15
missing=""
for ((i = 1; i <= attempts; i++)); do
  missing=""
  for pkg in $packages; do
    if ! curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json' "https://registry.npmjs.org/${pkg}" \
      | jq -e --arg v "$VERSION" '.versions[$v] != null' > /dev/null; then
      missing="${missing} ${pkg}"
    fi
  done
  if [ -z "$missing" ]; then
    echo "All packages resolve at ${VERSION} on npm."
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "Attempt ${i}/${attempts}: not yet on npm at ${VERSION}:${missing}"
  sleep "$interval"
done
echo "::error::Gave up waiting for${missing} at ${VERSION} on npm after $((attempts * interval))s. Does the version exist?"
exit 1

for f in /tmp/supabase-docker-images/*.tar.zst; do

done

steps.name: Install browser dependencies
steps.run:
# Ensure cache directory exists
mkdir -p "$PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR"
# Install Puppeteer Chrome for integration.browser.test.ts
# Only download if not already cached
# puppeteer is a devDep of @supabase/supabase-js (isolated pnpm mode).
if [ "${STEPS_PUPPETEER_CACHE_OUTPUTS_CACHE_HIT}" != "true" ]; then
  pnpm --filter @supabase/supabase-js exec puppeteer browsers install chrome

# Install Playwright browsers for WebSocket tests.

else

steps.name: Setup Supabase
steps.run: pnpm nx test:supabase:setup supabase-js

steps.name: Export auth keys
steps.run:
cd packages/core/supabase-js
echo SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY="$(pnpm exec supabase status --output json | jq -r '.ANON_KEY')" >> $GITHUB_ENV
echo "✅ Keys exported"

steps.name: Verify edge functions
steps.run:
cd packages/core/supabase-js
MAX_ATTEMPTS=10
RETRY_DELAY=3
HTTP_CODE=""
RESPONSE=""

for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
  echo "Attempt $attempt/$MAX_ATTEMPTS: Probing edge functions..."

  RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" \
    --connect-timeout 5 \
    --max-time 10 \
    -X POST \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"name":"CI"}' \
    http://127.0.0.1:54321/functions/v1/hello 2>/dev/null) || true

  HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -n1)

  if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
    echo "✅ Edge functions ready (attempt $attempt)"
    break
  fi

  echo "   Status: $HTTP_CODE (not ready yet)"

  if [ "$attempt" -lt "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
    echo "   Retrying in ${RETRY_DELAY}s..."
    sleep $RETRY_DELAY
  fi
done

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "200" ]; then
  echo "❌ Edge functions not responding after $MAX_ATTEMPTS attempts (final status: $HTTP_CODE)"
  echo "--- Edge functions log ---"
  cat /tmp/supabase-functions.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log available)"
  echo "--- End of log ---"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Prepare platform test dependencies
steps.run:
echo "📦 Installing dependencies for platform tests..."
echo "   Using --no-frozen-lockfile because preview packages bump versions on each run"
echo "   and the standalone sub-app lockfiles do not match the patched URLs."
echo ""

# --config.block-exotic-subdeps=false: these apps install supabase-js from
# pkg.pr.new URL tarballs whose published manifest references siblings by URL.

# because pnpm-workspace.yaml settings win over per-dir .npmrc even with
# --ignore-workspace.
cd packages/core/supabase-js/test/integration/next
pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --ignore-workspace --config.block-exotic-subdeps=false
pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

cd packages/core/supabase-js/test/integration/expo
pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --ignore-workspace --config.block-exotic-subdeps=false
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

cd packages/core/supabase-js/test/integration/bun
bun install
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

pipelines.name: Revert commit

steps.name: Check if actor is member of admin, sdk, or security team
Fail if not authorized
steps.run:
echo "You must be a member of @supabase/admin, @supabase/sdk, or @supabase/security to run this workflow."
exit 1

steps.name: Verify SHA exists and is reachable from master
steps.run:
if [[ ! "${SHA}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::sha input must be a 40-character commit SHA, got: ${SHA}"
  exit 1
fi
if ! git cat-file -e "${SHA}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "::error::Commit ${SHA} does not exist in this repository."
  exit 1
fi
if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "${SHA}" HEAD; then
  echo "::error::Commit ${SHA} is not reachable from master. Refusing to revert."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Revert and open PR
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

SHORT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=12 "${SHA}")
ORIGINAL_SUBJECT=$(git log -1 --pretty=%s "${SHA}")
BRANCH="revert/${SHORT_SHA}"

# Delete existing revert branch if a previous run left one behind
git push origin --delete "$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || true

git checkout -b "$BRANCH"

if git revert --no-edit "${SHA}"; then
  # Build conventional-commit subject. Cap at 100 chars (commitlint header-max-length).
  PREFIX="fix(${SCOPE}): revert \""
  SUFFIX="\""
  MAX=$((100 - ${#PREFIX} - ${#SUFFIX}))
  TRUNCATED="${ORIGINAL_SUBJECT}"
  if [ ${#TRUNCATED} -gt ${MAX} ]; then
    TRUNCATED="${TRUNCATED:0:$((MAX - 1))}…"
  fi
  NEW_SUBJECT="${PREFIX}${TRUNCATED}${SUFFIX}"

  git commit --amend \
    -m "${NEW_SUBJECT}" \
    -m "Reverts commit ${SHA}." \
    -m "Reason: ${REASON}"

  git push -u origin "$BRANCH"

  COMMIT_URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/commit/${SHA}"
  RUN_URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}"

  PR_BODY_FILE=$(mktemp)
  printf 'Reverts [`%s`](%s) — _%s_.\n\n## Reason\n%s\n\n---\nOpened by @%s via the [revert-commit workflow](%s).\n' \
    "$SHORT_SHA" "$COMMIT_URL" "$ORIGINAL_SUBJECT" "$REASON" "$ACTOR" "$RUN_URL" \
    > "$PR_BODY_FILE"

  gh pr create \
    --repo "${REPO}" \
    --base master \
    --head "$BRANCH" \
    --title "${NEW_SUBJECT}" \
    --body-file "$PR_BODY_FILE"

  # Request review from the workflow actor
  gh pr edit "$BRANCH" --add-reviewer "$ACTOR" || true

  echo "result=success" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  git revert --abort || true
  echo "result=conflict" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Notify on conflict
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
jq -n \
  --arg sha "$SHA" \
  --arg reason "$REASON" \
  --arg actor "$ACTOR" \
  --arg commit_url "$COMMIT_URL" \
  --arg run_url "$RUN_URL" \
  '{
    channel: "#team-sdk",
    username: "gha-failures-notifier",
    icon_emoji: ":warning:",
    attachments: [{
      color: "danger",
      title: "Revert workflow failed: conflicts (supabase-js)",
      text: "Could not automatically revert <\($commit_url)|\($sha)> on `master` — later commits touched the same lines, so manual resolution is needed.\n\n*Reason given:* \($reason)\n*Triggered by:* @\($actor)\n\n<\($run_url)|View logs>",
      footer: "revert-commit.yml"
    }]
  }' \
| curl -sS --fail-with-body -X POST "$SLACK_WEBHOOK" \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d @-
exit 1
